name: Bambu Lab printers
description: Progress, light, speed and camera of Bambu Lab printers over your network.
author: LocalAssistant

device.title: Add a Bambu Lab printer
device.description: On the printer: Settings, Network for the IP and access code, Settings, Device for the serial number. Turn on LAN-only mode and Developer Mode to send commands.

fields.name: host
fields.label: IP address
fields.message: Type the printer's IP address on your network.

fields.name: serial
fields.label: Serial number
fields.message: Type the serial number from the printer's settings.

fields.name: accessCode
fields.label: Access code
fields.message: Type the 8-character access code from the printer's network settings.
